|errata_history=Versions of '''Rebel Planners (V)''' in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (4 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): the Committee's interim rules supplement “Star Wars CCG Changes to Virtual Set #6” (“Updated 31 Dec 2003”; PDF dated 31 December 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf v6changes.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 15 June 2004), Section 1. Updated Light Side Texts: “Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: Once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system under your Starting Effect, and once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect. If Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table: Once per turn, you may disregard game text which prevents a Force drain from being cancelled. (Immune to Boring Conversation Anyway and Alter )” The supplement is “an official rules document” giving “interim updated card text”; it prints the text only (no slip, stats or lore), says the texts “are not final and may differ from the texts provided in the final version of Virtual Set #6”, and prints the arrow icon as “\/”. Stats and lore on this page are those of the January 2004 slip. This is the earliest surviving text: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. Image: the card's entry cut from the supplement ([[:File:OVS6-18-Rebel_Planners-interim-text-2003-12-31.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 2, slip 18 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: Once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system under your Starting Effect, and once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect. If Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table: Once per turn, you may disregard game text that prevents a Force drain from being cancelled. (Immune to Boring Conversation Anyway and Alter.)” The first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•18” at bottom right and no expansion icon. '''What changed''' (from the 31 December 2003 interim text): “game text which prevents” became “game text that prevents”; “Alter )” became “Alter.)”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata 2)]]): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004; listed on the Committee's Virtual Cards page as “Revised 10/12/2004”), page 2, slip 18, on the same old slip: “Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: Once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system under your Starting Effect, and once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect. If Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table: Once per turn, you may disregard game text which prevents a Force drain from being cancelled. (Immune to Boring Conversation Anyway and Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “that” became “which”. The slip mark at bottom right now reads “6•18a” (the January sheet: “6•18”).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata 3)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 18), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect; and, once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under your Starting Effect. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
